summary: Intuit Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $1.75B aggregate principal amount of senior notes in two tranches—$750M of 4.950% notes due 2031 and $1B of 5.500% notes due 2036—pursuant to a shelf registration statement. Net proceeds of ~$1.74B will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include refinancing $750M of 5.250% notes due 2026 and $500M of 1.350% notes due 2027. The notes were issued under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company, with BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, and Scotia Capital as underwriters. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
